scripts.dev: concurrently -n frontend,backend -c blue,green "node scripts/start-stage-frontend.mjs" "npm run dev --workspace backend"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace frontend && npm run build --workspace backend
scripts.verify:release: npm run build && npm run test:e2e:stage
scripts.test:unit: npm run typecheck:tests --workspace backend && node scripts/run-backend-unit-tests.mjs
